title: Rocket Garage
tagline: Snap together a silly rocket and blast it to the Moon, or watch it flop!
howToPlay: Tap parts to build a silly rocket, tap a planet on the top bar to choose where to go, press the big red 🚀, then tap or tilt to steer for stars. Wobbly rockets need bigger boosters, or they flop back onto the pad.
learning: Just for fun: building, steering and silly surprises (boosters and wobbly parts change the flight)
